name: claude-persistent-memory
description: Continuity-of-self memory for persistent-identity Claude Code agents. Phase-1a MVP: bundled `local-vault` CLI backing the Memory.* contract so the plugin works standalone on any project (no AgentSmith / no svc / no api dependency required); plugin scaffolding; standalone-mode `state` Memory.Store target recognized. Phase-1b will add the dreaming-model hooks (recall, consolidate-and-restart, context-pressure). Phase-1c will add auto-detection of an `agentsmith-api` backend (routes Memory.* to api when present; falls back to bundled CLI otherwise).
